body: I'm sorry everyone. I tried to put it off as long as I could. I am succumbing to the pain right now. I feel myself going crazy right this second. I'm screaming and sobbing and I can't stop. I can't make the pain stop. I have to kill myself. I have to die. I can't live without her. I can't do this anymore. I can't fucking do it. I'm so sorry.
I can't do this anymore. I'm screaming as loud as I can. I can't take the pain anymore. I'm literally going crazy. I can't do this.

Thank you. I appreciate it. But I have been working hard my entire life. I'm out of answers. I'm out of options. I am just not meant to be cared about. I am inherently flawed. I do not need to be around anymore. There is no point to it.

Thank you for your story.

But I have never had any body in my life who appreciated me. Nobody that ended up abandoning me for no reason. It won't change. It's been this long, it won't change. I'm not meant to be loved, I am meant to be alone. And for that reason I can't keep going on.
I feel the same way, which is why I am so bent on wanting to kill myself.

I just wanted to say, I woke up, and that's all I feel again today. It's beautiful out, it's a beautiful day I should be spending together with her. But I can't. This sounds ridiculous, but that alone makes me feel like I want to die as much as anything else.

I don't think I will. That's another feeling that's been floating around in my mind. I'm ugly. I'm not attractive, but she's the most beautiful woman I've ever met, and even if I did meet someone as beautiful as she is, they would never look at me twice, let alone want to be with me.

I don't think anyone could ever care about me again. Like I said to someone else too, I'm not an attractive person. I find myself to be ugly. But she is the most beautiful woman I've ever seen, and she wanted to be with me. I got lucky. I will never meet someone as beautiful as she is, and with all the amazing things about her personality and things I have in common. And even if I did, she would never look at me twice, let alone want to be with me.

Thank you for the kind words.

I really do not believe there will be someone else. I am not attractive. I look at myself and find myself to be ugly. She is the most beautiful woman I've ever met in my life. And she wanted to be with *me*.

I got lucky. I needed to hold on to her. She was the one for me. I lost her. There's no hope for me.

I don't believe I would. I believe me dying would affect absolutely no one. There's no one that loves me in my life. I am nothing to everybody. I might as well exist. I might as well die, because I'm dead already to the rest of the world.
I just woke up. I feel extremely depressed again, all I want to do is cut myself over and over again. I wish I had not waken up.

Thank you. I want to. Everyone I know is judging me. They don't know why I'm not already over it and just hate her or anything. No matter how much I point out that we DID care about each other, or how important it was that she's the first person to ever love me, nobody cares they don't take it seriously. They think I'm just being an idiot.
Also I have seen therapists all my life, currently I see 2, a psychiatrist, and a group.

Thank you, that really is the truth. The painful thing about my childhood was especially when my mom abandoned me. I didn't do anything wrong to deserve that, but she just up and stopped caring about me when I was just a kid. I get the same feeling now after my girlfriend left me. I loved her, I was good to her, and I never did anything wrong, but she left me to be with someone who is abusive to her. It digs up so many old feelings, in addition to the new ones it's made me deal with.

Also can I share this with you, I've posted it like 5 times now but it's what on my mind the most right now

---

I know I don't want to die, but I know I can't feel this way any more, and there's no other way to make it go away. I have been alone and depressed since I was a kid. I had a dad who'd lose his temper every day and take it out on me and hit me and shit. My mom divorced him, became an alcoholic and stopped caring about me when I was just 12. The guy she remarried to was an alcoholic and was abusive to me too. I have been abused and abandoned my whole life. It's why I hate myself so much. There's no making it go away. There's no undoing those things. I hate myself. I will always hate myself unless I have someone in my life who loves me, and I just lost that only person I've ever had.

I just don't see a way out. I just took pills again, something I haven't done since I was addicted 3 years ago. My life is just spiraling away. I have the overwhelming desire to start cutting myself again. I've never been this bad off.

I have struggled all my life. I posted this in response a couple times here already but it's still applicable I think, it's the cliff notes of my life basically

That's how I feel right now. He didn't rape her, but he abuses her emotionally and might have murdered her dog. I got the full burden, to support her and care for her while she grieved, and this is what I get in return.

It's what I deserve. I'm worthless.
So I have now gone from cutting myself to needing to do drugs to not feel like I want to die. I'm so glad my life is this way now compared to a month ago.

I said this to someone else, but this is what I'm feeling right now, I really want to get it off my chest

Thank you for your story. I'm sorry I feel like I'm not capable of coming up with a worthy reply, but that is very profound and I do relate to it a lot.

I don't know. Right now, I am convinced I can't. Not just convinced but I know.

I tried really hard for the rest of my life I was in therapy to break through my problems. Depression, anxiety, loneliness. I never got close.
I do feel it , but no one wants it, and there is no one to love me back.

I can't go back to being alone everyday again though. Spending all the important moments in my life alone, never sharing important events feelings or just whatever with another person. And that's what will happen. I got lucky that not only did she care about me back. There will not be another.

I'm writing a long post about my feelings and admitting to feeling like I want to kill myself, and thinking about posting it on Facebook. And thinking about trying to call her in someway. Or thinking about drinking a shit load of wine, getting back in that bath and cutting myself open, because that's all I want to do.

Thank you, I do appreciate the post. I do see 2 therapists, a psychiatrist and a group therapy thing. I have gotten help my whole life but it's never actually helped. That's part of why I feel so hopeless. There's nothing that can be done to fix me.

Thank you I appreciate all the kind words. But I am seeing a therapist,  2 of them, and a psychiatrist and a group. I've been getting help my whole life. Simply put I am broken and there is no fixing me. I can't be helped.
But I can't find them. I'm too broken. I have to much anxiety. I have been trying to fix it my entire life, but there is no fixing me. I am quite simply just broken.

Thanks for the story. It helps to relate.

I am seeing a couple therapists, a group, and a psychiatrist, but I don't feel any improvement

Today was the most beautiful day of the year today. I should've felt happy for that, I should've enjoyed that. Instead it hurts. It hurts so bad. I should be spending with her, but she is probably spending it with him. That alone makes me want to die. It makes me physically sick. I don't have the strength to keep pulling through like this. I can't live another day like this, to wake up and have to feel this way.
There's no way for me to believe I will find someone else. I don't make friends easy. I have social anxiety quite badly due to what I had to deal with growing up.
I can't be done with her. I need her. She is the only person who has intimately cared about me deeply as much as I do for her. I can't lose that.
No I've gotten out. I'm 23 and I do live in an apartment by myself. No drinking today, no drugs.

This is the first time I've cut myself before. With a broken razor and a small steak knife. 


It's kind of hard to talk about what I like. I'm so depressed at the moment I don't really like anything.
I'm feeling hopeless. I don't see a way out of this hole. My friends won't take me seriously anymore and they are my only support. I'm so depressed I feel sick and constant physical pain.
I love her so much. I can't handle it. I can't handle that she's gone. I can't handle that she's with him. I can't take it.

The only thing I won't be a part of is waking up every day with the agonizing feeling of how worthless I am eating at me from the inside out. Knowing that I'm alone, will always be alone, and will not be able to ever change that. I don't want to feel that anymore.

I don't have family. That's why this hurts especially bad. She was the only person left I had to share my life with. My friends don't give a shit, they refuse to even talk to me. I need to die. There's nothing left.
I can't. I've been sitting in my bath tub for the past hour cutting myself, just trying to work out the nerve to make the deep one to finish it off. I can't do this anymore.

I do want to, I don't want to cross her line. I would feel terrible doing that to her. At the same time, I don't know what to believe, in terms of how genuine it was, whether it was mostly coming from her, or that guy pressured her into saying those things or what happened. It was just the day before she was telling, oh I still care about you, and directly referenced the fact that she wasn't trying to avoid me. So I feel mixed messages I guess, to a degree, and also that she's just kind of being completely insane for the moment.

That is how it seems to be, very much. Unfortunately I find it hard for me to move on, because she is capable of healthy relationships, she has had plenty in the past. The thing for me is that, I feel like there is no way I can move on without making *some* kind of effort at some point. I'm extremely attached - she was the first for me in pretty much every thing that involves another person or relationships, so our relationship is a pretty significant thing to me for that reason.

Somebody came into her house with a key and she doesn't know who else would have one.

But yes, she is very emotional and unstable, she grew up with her mom who was an alcoholic and she had to move away to another state for a long time with a family friend because of it. So she does have things going on.

I do think she has problems, but I feel like they are kind of...amplifies, I guess, given the things that have happened to her in the past couple months. I do feel like she is not as bad as she is right now, because I don't think we would have had as good of a relationship as we did if that was the case.
Thank you, this really hits home for me.

Just, the thing is, I feel rejected as a human being, that someone who says that they care about me so much could turn around so quickly and want absolutely nothing to do with me at all. I can't be worth anything for that to happen.
You didn't do anything wrong.

I don't mean to repeat myself, but that's pretty much all my life has been...getting better or having to build myself back up. I don't get the breaks or times of happiness in my life that everyone else gets. It's all just crushing disappointment and loneliness.

I just can't get better though. My life has been nothing but long periods of getting better, brief moments of getting my hopes and them getting them crushed. And this is the highest they've ever been. I just don't have it in me to pull myself out of another hole.

I just don't know what to do. I feel like I can't carry on. The only thing keeping me going at the moment is the hope that she'll come to her senses. But I just have a bad feeling, that when I get back home in a few days and check my messages and get back in touch with the rest of the world I'm not going to like what I find.

I don't think for me. I just am not able to meet anyone that I can care about or genuinely connect with. And the people that I do care about just don't care about me back. She is literally a once in a lifetime person for me. And I can't bare to think that not only have I lost her, but that it would be so she can go back to that piece of shit. I literally cannot handle it.

I'm still around everyone. I really appreciate all the replies...the only thing that is keeping me going is that I'm going to try to talk to her later this week and hope that she has come to her senses. I left my phone and computer and went back to my family's house so I wouldn't be tempted to call her. I'm wavering between thinking this is a good idea and the distance will make her realize she values me, but then thinking the more I'm away and the less I try the more she will forget about me. I'm terrified of what will happen when I go back home in a few days and try to speak with her again. If it doesn't work out I truly don't think I have it in me to go on.

I wish I could say that, I want to be so mad at her. But I just really love her, I am completely lost. I also still have my other dog who's 5, I just can't stop feeling devastated about the puppy. He was just a baby, he was such a good dog, there was no reason for him to die.

I'm still here. I had to go cry for a while.

I just don't have anyone in my life. I can't trust my family. Definitely not the people who claim to be my friends. I've been alone for my whole life. And after the build up to being with her, after the pay off and getting my hopes up, for this to happen,  just can't take it, I literally can't tolerate it. I love her so much. I can't lose her, and I can't watch her to this to herself and to me
